protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No human dose. Animal-only reported amounts: mice about 0.4–3 mg/kg/day; monkey regimens were species-specific short daily cycles. A 5 mg + 2 mL dilution is reference math only. Monkey studies showed reversible kidney tubular dysfunction; not FDA-approved.
